rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: On the report of the Counting Commission, the Congress approves the results of the secret ballot on the question of the Chairman of the Council of Ministers (Government) of the Russian Federation. The resolution names no candidate and does not state the result.
rows.locator: Title; operative paragraph; signature 'Р. И. ХАСБУЛАТОВ', 9 декабря 1992 года, N 4063-I
